S2-D10 decision (audit D10, routed to me for Stage 3), decided as the contract lets me: ACCEPT-AND-DOCUMENT. The cap is resolved once at schedule time (sfxEngine.ts stateAt() at buses.duck) and is not re-resolved on story-lead onset. Reasoning: the shipImpact music row is 0.04 s attack, 0.1 s hold, 0.9 s release, 1.04 s total, while STORY_AUTHORITY_CROSSFADE_S is 4.5 s, so a beat that begins mid-duck has its mood at most 23 per cent into its fade-in when the uncapped duck has fully released; the worst case is 3 dB extra duck on a voice that has not yet arrived, and it is inaudible as a musical event. Re-resolving on onset would add a mid-envelope cancel-and-re-ramp on the music bus, one more write class in the exact frame Stage 3 is trying to make quiet, to correct a difference the ear cannot place. Stage 3 instruction: (a) document schedule-time resolution in the duckMatrix.ts header, mix README and score-treatment.md; (b) add a pure test pinning it: a duck scheduled with storyLead false whose story lead flips 0.2 s later keeps its full envelope points unchanged; (c) add a guard test that every DUCK_MATRIX row's attack plus hold plus release is at or under STORY_AUTHORITY_CROSSFADE_S divided by 2, so this decision reopens automatically if a deeper or longer row is ever added; (d) the Stage 3 audition's terminal-typing-over-story-lead script is listened to for exactly this seam and the result is recorded as delegated taste.
